title: The setup package -- the newest code and the only code a caregiver operates -- has no tests at all
method: grep of tests/ for cura.setup + whole-module sabotage replayed against the full suite in a hermetic copy

must_not_contain: stays green with these files replaced
no file in tests/ references cura.setup

observed_at_discovery: No file under tests/ mentions cura.setup or cura/setup. Each of the four setup modules (976 lines total) was replaced by `raise RuntimeError(...)` at import; the full suite reported '157 passed' every time. Everything the household depends on -- the medication list, the two check-in hours, the caregiver's number, the Twilio credentials -- is written by this untested code, and the 157-test suite is green whether it works or does not exist. Repro exit 1, 2 failed.
